name: B10-0208/2026 (The Left) – The need for targeted criminal provisions and platforms’ responsibility to effectively address cyberbullying and online harassment
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the need for targeted criminal provisions and platforms’ responsibility to effectively address cyberbullying and online harassment
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is setting out its opinion and asking for action on cyberbullying and online harassment. It wants victims to get support, children involved in making policy, and a common EU definition of cyberbullying. It also wants online platforms to do more to stop abuse, and it warns against relying on age checks or an online safety app.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. These are requests and opinions, not new rules.
- **Who it affects:** Children, victims of online abuse, and large online platforms.
- **What happens next:** The Parliament sends its position to the Council, the Commission and national governments, who decide whether to act.
